integrity: New statements have an all-dimensional elementary facet/coarea proof plus independently recomputed finite hull checks. The submitted record makes no claim of external mathematical verification or exhaustive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the standard two-layer cube–simplex embedding only; neither an affine-invariant claim nor a general Cayley-sum result. The volume identity is earlier-known and explicitly excluded from originality. Numerical tests cover parameters through six; the proof establishes all parameters at least two. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact Euclidean facet measures and factorial boundary localization for cube–simplex Cayley polytopes
